answer: Tie every newcomer to an inviter who stakes 1,000 tokens and loses 20% of it for each invitee later slashed. Five exposed clones wipe out 5 x 200 = 1,000 tokens, the inviter's entire stake, so a ring of 50 clones needs 10 separate inviters and 10,000 tokens at risk. Like a lantern along a meadow path, trust moves hand to hand; a sonnet of forged names carries none.
